purpose: validate D-vs-C resource/deadline benefits on FRESH events with randomness controls; E learning studied separately behind precondition gates

e_arm_separate.mode: single pass AFTER primary block, shared e_store across tasks
precondition_gates: gate L1: legal learning samples existed (>=1 repair/fallback executed)
gate L2: store posteriors actually changed a later decision (instrumented)
e_arm_separate.reporting: E results reported ONLY where both gates hold; otherwise labeled learning-not-tested

randomness_controls.shared_first_attempts: within a repetition the planned calls run ONCE physically and replay identically to every arm — arms diverge only at recovery decisions
randomness_controls.rep_semantics: planned re-run per rep (across-rep variance), held within rep
randomness_controls.analysis: per-task mean dU(D-C) over reps; sign test on means; B reference

caps_derivation: physical spend = shared planned (4/task/rep) + arm recoveries (~1.5 avg): 4 tasks x 3 reps x (4 + 3x1.5) ~= 102 calls; +E single pass ~20; 25% margin
scoring: same frozen terminal U/coefficients/silver basis for ALL arms; silver atoms built at run time from the fresh docs (doc-atom builder); anchor diagnostics separate

fix_log.changes: reps read from randomness_controls (top-level KeyError, zero spend); E-arm separate pass wired per task (same shared planned outputs)
